svg.title: URTC-TESTER architecture
svg.desc: URTC-TESTER connects to a URTC board through a USB-CAN adapter (SLCAN or SocketCAN), reads which of the 25 tool profiles the board is jumpered for and shows the controls and the telemetry of that tool in a Qt Quick window. It starts in listen-only mode, never touches flash and can also run without a window from test plans. Everything is tested against simulated boards; nothing has been run on a real board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A live CAN exerciser: it asks the board which tool it is, shows that tool's controls and telemetry, and transmits only when armed.
